newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$7.765 bln in funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$7.765 bln in funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank injected T$7.765 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations on Thursday, a central bank official said.
The bank, through three bills finance companies, bought T$7.765 billion in approved securities instruments from financial institutions with yields between 5.375 and 5.500 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments within 19 and 30 days.
